presentation.label: Hearing loss
presentation.free_text_prompt: Tell us about the hearing loss: when it started, which ear(s) are affected, how sudden it was, and whether you've had any other ear symptoms like pain, discharge, ringing, or dizziness.

questions.question: Did the hearing loss come on suddenly, over minutes to hours, or within the last 3 days?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate the hearing loss came on suddenly, over minutes to hours, or within the last 3 days?

questions.question: Is the hearing loss affecting one ear only, or both ears?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate the hearing loss is affecting only one ear (unilateral) rather than both ears?

questions.question: Did the hearing loss follow a head or ear injury, a very loud noise exposure, or a change in air pressure such as flying or diving?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate the hearing loss followed a head or ear injury, loud noise exposure, or a pressure change such as flying or diving?

questions.question: Do you have any new weakness or numbness in your face, arm, or leg, slurred speech, double vision, or problems with balance alongside the hearing loss?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate new facial, arm, or leg weakness/numbness, slurred speech, double vision, or balance problems alongside the hearing loss?

questions.question: Do you have severe spinning dizziness (vertigo), especially with vomiting, alongside the hearing loss?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate severe spinning vertigo, especially with vomiting, alongside the hearing loss?

questions.question: Do you have ear pain, swelling, or discharge along with a fever or feeling generally unwell?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate ear pain, swelling, or discharge together with a fever or feeling generally unwell?

questions.question: Have you noticed any weakness or drooping of one side of your face?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate weakness or drooping of one side of the face?

questions.question: Has the hearing loss been coming on gradually over months or years, rather than suddenly?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate a gradual pattern of hearing loss developing over months or years rather than a sudden onset?

questions.question: Do you have ringing, buzzing, or other noise in the ear (tinnitus)?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate ringing, buzzing, or other noise in the ear (tinnitus)?

questions.question: Does the ear feel blocked or full, as if it needs to pop, or have you had a cold or blocked nose recently?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate a blocked or full sensation in the ear, or a recent cold or blocked nose?

questions.question: How many days, weeks, or months have you had the hearing loss for?
questions.range_warning_text: That's a very long time to have had this symptom - please double check this number.

questions.question: Is there anything else about the hearing loss you'd like to describe, such as which ear is worse or what makes it better or worse?

ent_hearing_loss_sudden_unilateral_urgen.message: Sudden hearing loss in one ear can be sudden sensorineural hearing loss, which needs assessment and treatment within 24-48 hours to give the best chance of recovery. Call the surgery today, or go to A&E/an emergency ENT service if the surgery is closed, instead of sending an online form.

ent_hearing_loss_sudden_bilateral_urgent.message: Sudden hearing loss needs prompt assessment. Call the surgery and ask to speak to the duty doctor today instead of sending an online form.

ent_hearing_loss_neuro_symptoms_urgent.message: Hearing loss with new weakness, numbness, slurred speech, double vision, or balance problems can be a sign of stroke and needs urgent assessment. Call 999 or go to A&E instead of sending an online form.

ent_hearing_loss_facial_weakness_urgent.message: Hearing loss with weakness or drooping on one side of the face needs urgent assessment. Call 999 or go to A&E instead of sending an online form.

ent_hearing_loss_severe_vertigo_urgent.message: Hearing loss with severe spinning dizziness and vomiting needs prompt assessment. Call the surgery and ask to speak to the duty doctor instead of sending an online form.

ent_hearing_loss_trauma_urgent.message: Hearing loss following a head or ear injury, loud noise exposure, or a pressure change needs prompt assessment. Call the surgery and ask to speak to the duty doctor instead of sending an online form.

ent_hearing_loss_infective_symptoms_urge.message: Ear pain, swelling, or discharge with a fever or feeling generally unwell needs prompt assessment. Call the surgery and ask to speak to the duty doctor instead of sending an online form.
